## Invariants → checks — 67 sections in `.ai-context/invariants.md`

| invariant (line) | check (smoke.mjs line) |
|---|---|
| The library renders, and it renders quietly (101) | __vs is present and the library rendered (377); the page loads with no console errors (371) |
| The seven default shelves are the seven default shelves (110) | — no check named in the section |
| A shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (117) | a shelf's note count is unique notes, never the sum of its books (390) |
| Every note has at least one address (130) | every note reachable from the vault is on at least one shelf (403) |
| A book opens on its oldest note (138) | date contents default to oldest and saved newest settings remain readable (469) |
| Notes sharing a date read A-Z, in both directions (147) | notes sharing a date list A-Z in both reading directions (488) |
| A note with no date of its own (170) | a note with no date of its own takes the earliest stamp the file has (571) |
| Undated is a book, not a guess (184) | an undated note lands in Undated, not in a guessed year (416) |
| The ISO week keeps its week-year (199) | an ISO week keeps its week-year across a January boundary (608) |
| The Encyclopedia opens with 0-9 (208) | the Encyclopedia opens with a 0-9 volume, not ten one-note books (624) |
| Plaques are date-only and asked for (216) | year plaques only appear on date classifiers, and only when asked for (635); a plaque sits under the books it names, in the same scroller (652); years group under decade plaques, and a run that wraps is named on both rows (1122) |
| A plaque opens its run (262) | a ribbon left in a plaque-book re-resolves after a rebuild, and the Reading shelf holds it (754) |
| The Reading shelf is a row, and it is packed tight (282) | the Reading shelf lays its books in a row, and draws as many rows as it packed (799); on a manual shelf a plate opens what is under it, not the whole letter (944); a plaque sits under the books it names, in the same scroller (652) |
| A book is as thick as it is full (337) | a spine's thickness is its note count (1422) |
| An impossible date is not a date (367) | an impossible date is not a date, and never a fifteenth month (428) |
| Book addresses are stable across a rebuild (385) | book addresses are stable across a rebuild (1456) |
| Filters change membership and nothing else (391) | a filter changes membership without moving a shelf (1467) |
| A reorder of the shelves themselves survives the reload (401) | a reordered shelf survives a reload, on both hosts (1490) |
| A shelf arranged by hand moves nothing but the sequence (445) | a shelf arranged by hand keeps every address and starts where it stood (1584); Alt+Right moves a book one place, and it survives a rebuild and a reload (1617); a drag and drop moves a book the same way a key does, across rows (1658); saved reading order leaves an arranged shelf alone (1722); a book nobody has arranged stands at the end of the shelf (1758); a filter narrows an arranged shelf without shuffling it (1786) |
